content: We map every other sentence $x$ to the keyword with which they have maximum similarity $Max_y (S(x,y))$ . Later, we cluster the keywords along with the sentences mapped to them. The value of $t$ signifies the importance to be given to the keyword and its associated sentences respectively. In our experiments, we empirically fix the value of $t$ to $0.25$ .
